author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
## What
Adds `@sparkle/test-utils` as a `workspace:*` devDependency of `apps/moo-dang`.

## Why
`pnpm test` on `main` was failing: 6 of 17 moo-dang test files (`App.test.tsx`, `shell-e2e.test.tsx`, `help-command-fix.test.tsx`, `components/Terminal.test.tsx`, `shell/wasm.test.ts`, `shell/wasm-integration.test.ts`) import from `@sparkle/test-utils` subpaths (`/console`, `/dom`, `/react`, `/terminal`), but the package was never declared as a dependency in `apps/moo-dang/package.json`. Under pnpm's strict, non-hoisted linking this left the package unresolved in `node_modules`, breaking Vite's module resolution for every test file that imports it.

## Fix
- Added `"@sparkle/test-utils": "workspace:*"` to `devDependencies` (matches internal-dependency convention).
- Regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml`.

## Verification
- `pnpm check` — clean (manypkg, types, turbo config, dependency validation, lint)
- `pnpm build` — 10/10 Turborepo tasks green
- `pnpm test` — 17/17 test files, 445 passed / 1 skipped (previously 11/17 files, 358 passed)
- `pnpm fix` — no additional diff
